course.title: Applied Statistics and Queuing Theory
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: The probability that a medical diagnostic test correctly identifies someone with the illness as positive is 0.99, and the probability that the test correctly identifies someone without illness as negative is 0.95. The incidence of illness in the general population is 0.001. You take the test, and the result is positive. What is the probability that you have the illness?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
